title: A draft push starts its lane-touched-tests run
why: PR #3126 (scratchpad-cp-keeps-writer, head 10d984931) has no lane-touched-tests run on any head after cb15b3758, so merge --lane-lint reads unknown and needs the owner's --lint-unknown-ok (Cockpit item 692, coordinator 10:48 CST Nov 13). #2932 hit the same class. Lanes must not kick CI by hand.
note: Find why Actions starts no lane-touched-tests run on some draft pushes (trigger filter, paths, concurrency cancel or the draft rule), and fix the trigger so every pushed lane head gets one run. Related: step batch-build-reads-draft-runs (done) reads the run; step ready-pr-touched-tests measures the ready side. Done when: a draft push in a test repo or a dry-run of the workflow trigger shows the run starts for each head. Cause found (coordinator 10:51 CST Nov 13): #3126 conflicted with main, and GitHub starts no pull_request run on a conflicted PR. Fix changes to: merge --lane-lint reads a conflicted PR and says "PR conflicts with main: merge main" instead of "unknown". The coordinator tells the lane. Item 692 withdrawn.
